title: Mediterranean Blue Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand, 49-Inch Solid Brass, Soho Collection, Allied Brass
description: Freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand, 49-inch tall with 12 in x 9.25 in footprint, solid brass construction for bathroom towel storage and drying — available in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Modern, clean-lined Soho Collection design in a vertical stand format; four pivoting arms maximize space and separate towels for faster drying. Heavy weighted base helps prevent tipping and includes a felt pad to protect floors and countertops. Corrosion-resistant, rust-free performance with a designer lifetime finish. Supports up to 20 lb. Some assembly required. Includes towel stand. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass, Soho collection.
